title: The Twin Equilibrium Canon
summary: A canon of two equal weights held in the qi field that turn every blow into the pull of the opposite pan.

title: Treatise of the Paired Balance
summary: A treatise on the beam and the two pans that cancels a strong force by laying its equal against the other side.

title: The Basin Measure Mastery
summary: A mastery of filling and emptying the body like a measured basin so that it takes in surplus and gives back lack.

title: The Plateau Level Canon
summary: A canon of planing every rise and hollow of a field flat so that no extreme can stand on it.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Anchored Scale
summary: A treatise on a scale anchored by oath so that it weighs true in any wind and weighs the oath-breaker heavy.

title: Manual of the Bearing Mean
summary: A manual of taking a bearing on the mean line between two forces and holding to it through any storm.
